description: Passages piétons sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche de points localise les passages piétons sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole et a pour objet de faciliter le suivi des travaux de mise en conformité des traversées. La qualification de la base de donnée n'est aujourd'hui pas exhaustive sur le territoire métropolitain. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are zone piétonnière. The portal shows 11,068 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
